1. 1.calibration — Your calibration program covering production gauges (procedure and current calibration records).
2. 4.cleanliness — The internal cleanliness test report (particle counts per part against the drawing limits).

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts

audit_plan.question: No cleanliness report is in the packet. Ask to see particle-extraction results per complete internal wetted circuit against Stark's limits (≤ 100 particles ≥ 100 µm, 0 particles ≥ 500 µm) and the test method used.

reliability_report.md §1.5 says methods and criteria are documented but gives no sample-size basis. Ask how sample sizes for leak, burst, cleanliness and material cert were chosen, and for the statistical rationale or standard.
The packet has no financial health indicator. Ask for the supplier's current financial indicator and its source, such as audited statements or a credit report.
